checkpoint_run_function: run a function with activation checkpointing to trade compute for memory savings
checkpoint_sequential_split_model: split a sequential model into segments and checkpoint each segment to reduce memory usage
set_checkpoint_early_stop_disable_recomp: disable early stopping so checkpoint recomputes the full function during backward pass
set_checkpoint_debug_enabled_capture_tra: enable debug mode to capture stack traces and operation logs for checkpoint determinism errors
DefaultDeviceType_set_device_type_config: set the default device type used for checkpoint RNG state stashing and restoration
